metadata.question: Does Dorsoidong Co Lake have a lighter blue color than Chibzhang Co Lake in October 12, 1987?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare water color (blue reflectance) between two lakes on a specific date (October 12, 1987) - For 1987, Landsat 5 is available - Water color can be assessed using blue band reflectance - Need to identify coordinates for both lakes 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds to get clear water reflectance - May need to use a date range around October 12, 1987 if exact date image isn't available - Focus on water bodies only 3. Logic: - Compare mean blue band reflectance between the two lakes - Higher blue reflectance = lighter blue color - Valid result: A (Dorsoidong lighter) or B (Chibzhang lighter or equal) - Check for C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define lake locations (Tibet region) // Dorsoidong Co: approximately 31.95°N, 89.65°E const dorsoidong = ee.Geometry.Point([89.65, 31.95]); // Chibzhang Co: approximately 31.45°N, 90.15°E const chibzhang = ee.Geometry.Point([90.15, 31.45]); // Create buffer zones for sampling const dorsoidongRegion = dorsoidong.buffer(1000); const chibzhangRegion = chibzhang.buffer(1000); // Target date with some flexibility const targetDate = '1987-10-12'; const startDate = '1987-10-01'; const endDate = '1987-10-31'; // Landsat 5 collection for 1987 let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(dorsoidong.buffer(50000)); const collectionSize = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log('Total images found:', collectionSize); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No images found for October 1987.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get the closest image to target date const image = collection.sort('system:time_start').first(); const imageDate = new Date(image.get('system:time_start').getInfo()); console.log('Using image from:', imageDate.toISOString().split('T')[0]); // Apply scaling factors for Landsat Collection 2 function applyScaling(img) { const optical = img.select('SR_B.*').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return img.addBands(optical, null, true); } const scaledImage = applyScaling(image); // Use blue band (SR_B1 for Landsat 5) const blueImage = scaledImage.select('SR_B1'); // Calculate mean blue reflectance for Dorsoidong Co const dorsoidongStats = blueImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: dorsoidongRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const dorsoidongBlue = dorsoidongStats.get('SR_B1_mean').getInfo(); const dorsoidongCount = dorsoidongStats.get('SR_B1_count').getInfo(); console.log('Dorsoidong Co - Blue:', dorsoidongBlue, 'Pixels:', dorsoidongCount); // Calculate mean blue reflectance for Chibzhang Co const chibzhangStats = blueImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: chibzhangRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const chibzhangBlue = chibzhangStats.get('SR_B1_mean').getInfo(); const chibzhangCount = chibzhangStats.get('SR_B1_count').getInfo(); console.log('Chibzhang Co - Blue:', chibzhangBlue, 'Pixels:', chibzhangCount); // Validation if (dorsoidongCount === 0 || chibzhangCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (dorsoidongBlue === null || chibzhangBlue === null || isNaN(dorsoidongBlue) || isNaN(chibzhangBlue) || dorsoidongBlue < 0 || dorsoidongBlue > 1 || chibzhangBlue < 0 || chibzhangBlue > 1) { console.log('Invalid reflectance values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: lighter blue = higher blue reflectance if (dorsoidongBlue > chibzhangBlue) { console.log('Dorsoidong Co has lighter blue color.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Chibzhang Co has equal or lighter blue color.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
